text_block_list.text:
Around the same time as Air Groove's rise, 
her acquaintance Silence Suzuka was also 
making waves and stealing the public 
spotlight.

Air Groove ran a practice race against 
her, only to suffer a crushing defeat at 
the hands of the runner heralded as the 
"Extradimensional Escapist."

Silence Suzuka stands before her as a 
formidable wall. Setting her goal as 
"Defeat Silence Suzuka," Air Groove 
decides to enter the Osaka Hai.
